A few years ago I visited a maple syrup farm and took a picture of the different grades of maple syrup

Maple is a beautiful sugar. I'm a little biased since I work with it in my job, but it's great in so many things, from glazes to simple syrup for cocktails (works well with citric based cocktails!)

All credit to farmers working their sugar shacks.

The farm I visited used these to illustrate the different grades of maple syrup. According to Wikipedia, "Extra Light and Grade A typically have a milder flavour than Grade B, which is very dark, with a rich maple flavour.[56] The dark grades of syrup are used primarily for cooking and baking, although some specialty dark syrups are produced for table use.[58] Syrup harvested earlier in the season tends to yield a lighter color.[59] "

That visit gave me a huge appreciation for everything behind that product. Never again did I think it was expensive.

My boyfriend thinks that table syrup (aka corn syrup with maple flavor) is the same, if not better, than real maple syrup.

No. Just, no.

Taxpayers have spent $4.7 billion since 1997 for NFL stadiums. The NFL made $7.24 billion last year.

Well when you put it that way...

But honestly, why cities approve millions for these stadiums is beyond me. Even leaving Candlestick for the new Levi Stadium has made me less likely to want to visit a game.

They do it because they don't want the team to leave.

Even if every current NFL city got together and said they wouldn't pay a dime for a new stadium, you'd still have cities currently without teams who would pay through the nose to get a team.

I hate to put it like this, but politicians view paying a for a profit based sports team to stay, even if it means a loss of revenue for the city, as a good investment (or at least good PR).

Just look at how bitter lots of Baltimore fans still are about the Colts, Cleveland fans are about the Ravens. That's how bitter the fans of St. Louis, San Diego, and Oakland could be.

Not defending the practice, just looking at the unfortunate reality.
